result:
Only the AgentTest file exists under test, and only one test fails — the rest of the suite (61 tests) passes cleanly.

I wrote `CSVFormatAgentTest` (62 tests) covering builder defaults, validation errors (line breaks, empty/null delimiters, clashing delimiter/quote/escape/comment characters, `QuoteMode.NONE` without escape, duplicate-header modes), `newFormat`, header/header-comment copy semantics, `equals`/`hashCode`/`toString`, printing (`print`, `printRecord`, `println`, `format`), parsing integration, predefined-format field values, `getMaxRows`/`useRow`, and deprecated bridging methods.

**61 tests pass.** One test fails and shows a real bug:

- `testNullStringNotCorruptedWhenQuoteCharacterUnsetAtSetNullStringTime` — `CSVFormat.Builder.setNullString(String)` precomputes `quotedNullString` as `quoteCharacter + nullString + quoteCharacter` using raw string concatenation, with no fallback for a `null` quote character (unlike `setQuote`, which falls back to the default `"` when `null`). If the quote character is disabled (`setQuote(null)`) before `setNullString` is called, and no subsequent `setQuote` call recomputes it, the boxed `null` `Character` is concatenated as the literal text `"null"`, corrupting the output. With `.setQuote(null).setNullString("NULL").setQuoteMode(QuoteMode.ALL)`, printing a `null` value produces `"nullNULLnull"` instead of the expected `"NULL"`.
